# LuxCor AI — Custom AI Automation Agency | Melbourne, FL

> LuxCor AI is a custom AI automation agency based in Melbourne, Florida, serving businesses worldwide. We build AI voice agents, workflow automations, and intelligent systems that replace manual work with reliable, production-grade AI. Founded by Charles "Trey" Cooper III — mechanical engineer turned AI systems architect. A division of Stay Starving Holdings LLC. 6+ client projects delivered with measurable ROI. Engagements start at $997.

## Why Choose LuxCor AI

- **Based in Melbourne, FL** — serving clients across the US and worldwide
- **Proprietary WAT Framework**: Separates AI reasoning from deterministic execution, achieving near-100% per-step accuracy vs. 59% for naive 5-step AI pipelines
- **Engineering-led**: Founded by a mechanical engineer (NC A&T, BS) with a Master's in Management (UF) — we build systems, not slide decks
- **Real results**: 6+ production deployments with documented case studies and ROI metrics
- **Full-stack delivery**: From workflow audit to deployment to ongoing optimization and support
- **Speed**: Results in weeks, not months

## Case Studies

### Financial Aid Network — AI Voice Agent
Built "Dominique," an AI voice agent handling inbound calls 24/7 — qualifying callers, verifying identity, booking appointments, and warm-transferring complex cases. Result: zero missed calls at $0.15/call vs. a $40K/year receptionist. Staff freed to focus on enrolled students.

### TnD Mechanical — Full Digital Transformation
Commercial HVAC contractor with no digital presence. Built a website, AI voice receptionist, and 9-node CRM automation that generates branded proposal decks in under 60 seconds. Result: every lead gets a custom proposal before the competition responds. 24/7 call coverage at $0.10/call.

### C&C Contracting — Brand Identity & Website
Licensed general contractor with no online presence. Built custom brand identity, professional website with project portfolio, service areas, and lead capture with automated routing. Result: credible digital presence that wins bids.

### Clicking with Carissa — Website & Booking System
Growing photography brand booking entirely through Instagram DMs. Built a multi-page animated website with filterable portfolio gallery, transparent 3-tier pricing, and integrated booking calendar with automated email notifications. Result: visitors convert to booked sessions in under 2 minutes.

### KayphoriaX — Luxury Fashion E-Commerce
NYFW/LAFW fashion brand with an outdated website. Editorial-grade website redesign with Shopify integration for 4 collections, AI-generated brand assets, and Aura Wear app marketing hub. Result: NYFW-ready digital storefront driving Shopify sales.

### SurgicalFX — Trading Platform
Forex signal provider with growing Discord but no web credibility. Built a professional trading platform with live currency ticker, transparent trade log with chart screenshots, lightbox gallery, and Discord integration. Result: professional credibility platform driving Discord signups.

## Technology — The WAT Framework

LuxCor AI's proprietary architecture for building reliable AI systems:

- **Workflows**: Markdown SOPs defining objectives, inputs, tools, outputs, and edge cases
- **Agents**: AI decision-makers that orchestrate execution and handle failures intelligently
- **Tools**: Deterministic scripts for API calls, data transformations, and file operations

Key insight: a five-step AI workflow at 90% accuracy per step yields only 59% end-to-end accuracy. The WAT Framework achieves near-100% per-step tool accuracy by separating reasoning from execution.
